summary: Master budget performance analysis and forecasting to improve control, accuracy, and reporting. Join TrainingCred’s 5-day intermediate course.
lede: Budget performance analysis helps finance professionals compare actuals with budgets and explain the drivers behind variances. This training develops skills in KPI-based variance analysis, driver-based rolling forecasts, and scenario planning, with practice building dashboards and reporting packs for management reviews. It also covers forecast assumptions and communicating results to non-finance stakeholders.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for finance professionals who need to analyze budget execution, explain variances, and improve forecast quality in day-to-day planning cycles.
prerequisites: To participate effectively, you should bring a laptop with Microsoft Excel installed and be ready to work with spreadsheet-based exercises. Power BI and planning-platform examples are included as working references, and any organization-specific data used in practice should be anonymized before the course.
